label: Acoustic
definition: Pressure waves in gas or liquid detected through auditory or vibration-sensitive systems

label: Visual
definition: Optical or visual displays perceptible to receivers

label: Chemical
definition: Chemical substances emitted or presented and detected by chemosensory systems

label: Substrate-borne vibration
definition: Mechanical vibration transmitted through solids or water surfaces

label: Electrical
definition: Electric fields or discharges detected through electroreception
